# cpanel_filesystem_directory (Data Source)

Looks up one directory below `public_html` in a cPanel account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_filesystem_directory" "assets" {
  path = "public_html/assets"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The normalized directory path below `public_html`, relative to the cPanel account home.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_path` (String) The absolute directory path reported by cPanel.
- `permissions` (String) The four-digit octal directory permissions reported by cPanel.
